findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 8 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 8.1 1, 8.2 1, 8.3 1, 8.6 1, 8.7 1, 8.8 7, 8.9 5, 8.11 1, 8.12 1, 8.13 1, 8.14 1, 8.15 1, 8.16 2.

15 theory questions (events, establishment of equilibrium, vapour pressure, conditions and features, types, law of mass action, units, the four constants, Le Chatelier's principle with concentration, pressure, temperature and catalyst, Haber process, SO₃) and 9 numericals (Kc from equilibrium data, Kc from initial data, Kp from Kc, Kp from partial pressures, Kp from mole fractions) with new values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed: BiCl₃ Kc without solid BiOCl = [HCl]²/[BiCl₃][H₂O], solid BiOCl does not shift the equilibrium, cooling raises Kc for SO₃, Kp = Kn(P/N)^Δn.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
